feedbackActionPlan.summary: Add a Joint Collar Color selection to the custom cue ordering flow with included standard choices of black, white, and brown, plus an extra-cost custom color request path.
feedbackActionPlan.customerImpact: Customers currently cannot specify the visible joint collar color during configuration, which can lead to mismatched cue aesthetics, follow-up support conversations, incorrect assumptions about defaults, and order revisions after purchase.
feedbackActionPlan.businessImpact: Adding the option reduces manual clarification, improves custom order accuracy, and creates a clear upsell path for non-standard collar colors that require additional material sourcing or labor.
feedbackActionPlan.confidence: The raw feedback is explicit about the missing option and standard colors. Repository inspection did not surface a website or product customizer implementation in this checkout, so implementation surface details are framed as product and UX assumptions rather than file-specific changes.

researchFindings.finding: Raw feedback requests joint collar color options specifically for black, white, and brown, with additional colors treated as extra-cost custom requests.

External cue-building supply references list black and white joint collar components as common stock materials; brown or natural phenolic-style collars are also common in cue construction, supporting the proposed standard option set.

Custom cue and repair forms commonly treat collar, joint, matching, or non-standard material work as separately priced or quote-dependent, supporting an extra-cost custom-color path rather than unlimited free color choices.

Assumption: this checkout appears to contain a billiards physics/visualization project, not the customer-facing website, because searches for website package roots and collar-related product option code did not identify an implementation surface.

implementationPlan.step: Locate the custom cue product configurator schema or option source of truth for visual cue-build attributes.
Add a new option group labeled Joint Collar Color in the section where joint, collar, diameter, pin, or other cue-joint options are configured.
Define included standard choices Black, White, and Brown with no price adjustment and stable internal values such as black, white, and brown.
Add a Custom Color choice that clearly indicates extra cost applies and reveals a required free-text field for the requested color or material match.
Route Custom Color selections into the cart, order summary, admin/order detail, and fulfillment payload with both the selected custom flag and customer-entered request text.
Configure pricing so Custom Color applies the approved surcharge or quote-required state, while Black, White, and Brown remain included.
Add helper copy explaining that custom collar colors or material matching may add cost and may require shop confirmation before production.
Validate required-field behavior so the order cannot be submitted with Custom Color selected and an empty custom color request.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The custom cue flow displays a Joint Collar Color option group.
Black, White, and Brown are selectable standard options with no added charge.
A Custom Color option is available and visibly marked as extra cost or quote-required before checkout.
Selecting Custom Color requires the customer to enter the desired color or material-matching request.
The selected collar color appears consistently in cart, checkout/order review, customer confirmation, and internal order/production views.
Custom Color pricing or quote handling is included in the order total or clearly blocks automatic pricing until staff review, according to the business pricing model.

risks.risk: If production cannot source a requested custom color, customers may expect guaranteed fulfillment unless helper copy sets quote and confirmation expectations.
If the option is added only to the front end and not order fulfillment data, production may still miss the collar color selection.
Brown may mean different materials or shades, so product copy should confirm whether it means brown, natural phenolic, or another shop-standard material.
Custom Color surcharge behavior needs alignment with the existing pricing engine to avoid undercharging.

openQuestions.question: What exact surcharge or quote workflow should apply to Custom Color joint collars?
Should Brown be labeled Brown, Brown Phenolic, or Natural Brown to match shop terminology and available stock?
Are custom collar colors limited to a predefined palette, or should customers enter any requested color for staff review?
Should custom collar color selection affect production lead time messaging?
